reviews.text: Good experience good people

I had a really disappointing experience today, especially considering how highly I’ve thought of this place in the past. Even after moving to the suburbs, I still drive about 40 minutes to come here because this used to be the best place for my pet. I’ve even recommended your services to 6–8 of my neighbors.

Today, after Bijou was finished, I received six phone calls even after I had already explained that my cousin was on her way to pick Bijou up and that I was currently in a meeting. The repeated calls were very disruptive and unnecessary.

Unfortunately, this is not the first issue I’ve experienced. The last time walnut was groomed, she had significant skin irritation after the haircut.

I’m very disappointed with the service and overall experience, especially given how loyal I’ve been and how many people I’ve recommended to you. I really hope you can take this feedback seriously.
I love the grooming room, great staff, and great customer service. The price is always reasonable.
This is a great groomer! We love taking our dog here.

My mom brought her yorkie here. The grooming was fine. The first time was fine. Although the second time was unacceptable and unprofessional. She had dropped her off at 11:30 to be groomed. They did not specify a “specific” time they wanted her to be back my mom didn’t know when she would be done? They closed at 3. My mom had went to a job and they blew up her phone consistently to come pick her up immediately from 12:30-1:30. She called them back at 1:45 telling them she was on the way and they were rude and saying that they have been calling her to come pick her up immediately. She got there at 2:30 BEFORE CLOSING. and they talked to her disrespectful and rude. Also they stated it was $60 before the grooming and suddenly it was $72 when she came back what a coincidence. Also be mindful before grooming and after they will put your pet in a cage in the basement aka the dungeon.

I have a German Shepherd/Alaska Malamute mix, and if you are not aware, they should NOT be shaved. I told the lady on the phone “Do not shave him.” Her exact words “We do not shave those dogs”. My dog was SHAVED today. I am in awe.. This “groomer” ruined his coat.  Never again will I bring my dog back here. TERRIBLE. I wouldn’t even give this place 1 star. If you are working at a dog grooming facility, you should know better than to shave a dog that has a double-coat.. Stupidity.
The first picture is how he looks normally, the rest of the pictures speak for itself.
Very caring staff
Great staff and customer service all the time
The Groomin Room did a great job on my Yorkshire Terrier (Foxy) today thank you so much.

I booked this appointment after my coworker recommended the place, and I can see why people keep coming back. My german shepherd sheds constantly, especially during warm weather, and the deshedding treatment actually made a noticeable difference. Fur stopped covering my car seats immediately afterward. The groomer explained which brush would help maintain his coat at home instead of trying to sell random products. My dog also smelled clean without that heavy perfume scent that some grooming salons overdo.

First time here and the staff was amazing! The ladies at the front were really nice and took time to explain things to me. I didn’t meet my groomer in person but her name is Sarah and she did an amazing job! I definitely will be returning

The lady at the front desk that I spoke to today is very rude and disrespectful. She answered the phone and then pretended that she couldn’t hear me and when I said, are you able to hear me now she said yes with an attitude and then proceeded to aunt me what service do I want and then hang up the phone as I was explaining myself that’s very rude and unethical as a business you need to do better because I know that I thought I was there in person the chances of you giving me an attitude is less likely versus talking to me over the phone so how you act in person is how you should be acting when you’re speaking to someone over the phone so I’m gonna give you guys one star because that was very rude and disrespectful.

I’ve been coming here for years and today that ends! I brought one of my dogs (10 pound yorkie) in to get a full grooming. I’m always an owner stay never had an issue up until the last few visits on asking why I want to stay. The older lady with red short hair didn’t like my response which was I just wanted to be in & out. She then got smart and said that’s not a reason to use owner stay. the real reason they don’t want owners to stay is because all they do is gossip about clients and their pets. Also when you aren’t an owner stay your dog is in a cage until a spot is available for them to get groomed and you to pick them up which typically takes 3 hours. When I was sitting they proceeded to whisper not only between them but a underage child because the lady with short side bangs had her daughter there with her at the desk on how they were going to charge me more for being an owner stay. When it was time to pay is when I had a issue with the lady that sits next to her with short side bangs, & loud squeaky like voice overcharging for the grooming service that has always been the same! Stating they raised prices back in January of 2023. So if that was the case why does my payments from the grooming room pull up the same amount each time? They did try to overcharge a while back and we got that settled REAL QUICK never had an issue again until today. Her service has always been $55 not $65 after tax $72. She overcharged purposely to be smart and I will surely take my money & dog elsewhere. Let’s not mention they overcharge owners and a lot of people are unaware they just pay because that’s what they’re told the price is. I overheard them once speaking about a dog name Riley being overcharged accidentally but since they’ve been overcharging the man of that dog they were going to keep charging him that amount. Like what? Do better respectfully. PLEASE BEWARE they charge by the dogs pound do not let those 2 ladies that have been working there for over 10+ years with no life gossiping at the front desk fool you. They aren’t the owners so I feel bad for the lovely lady of this establishment but unfortunately your employees are a reflection of your place. Today they lost 2 loyal customers due to their actions. If one of those ladies at the front desk would like to reply to this review respond with PROOF we were not overcharged today. Show PROOF of the last 2 years. they just don’t like owner stays thats all. Take your dogs/cats elsewhere if you want better treatment please.
I was only there for a short time. I went in with my Chihuahua and asked if someone could clip her nails. Rita got her nail clippers and was finished in about 2 minutes and my dog was fine with it.
This is ABSOLUTELY THE BEST Groomer around. Prices and the care and Love they give the pet's Re AWESOME
First time we took our dog here and they were great! She looked amazing afterwards and they took great care of her while there!
My dog fletch loves it here.

Was able to get squeezed into a day-of appointment just a few days before christmas. It was the first time our pit was taken to the groomer, and we had a fantastic experience!! Recieved a very happy, handsome man afterwards - with perfectly trimmed nails!! Extremely affordable with skilled groomers, definitely would recommend and will be returning in the future.
SARA is a gem
My dog gets so excited to go to The Groomin Room. She is usually a scary dog but loves everyone there and enjoys her bath etc.

I highly recommend I've been taking my dog here for many years they're the best.
Ask for Rachel she's the only one I trust with him.
The ONLY place that can cut my chiweenie’s nails without him trying to claw them to death. They are awesome, all the groomers here are great!

We were recommended to the grooming room as a back up when our normal groomer wasn't available (by our groomer.) They were friendly from the time they answered the phone to make the appointment all the way to I picked up my puppers to leave ☺️, they got her hair cut spot on to what I wanted which I have to say is a first for an actual groomers, which is why went to a private groomer. All in all, I'd definitely come back if I needed another groomer again without hesitation, they weren't much more expensive then what I normally pay so I wasn't breaking the bank either unlike PetSmart.

We’ve been bringing our cat here for the past two years for trims and dry baths, since she cannot tolerate wet baths. She’s always been a floofy cat, and her coat was just starting to grow back in nicely, all she needed was a routine trim as usual.

Instead, we were handed back our cat shaved down in a full lion cut. The front desk admitted that the groomer mistook her for another cat and even gave her a wet bath (which we specifically avoid due to her not liking them at all), and then told us they were giving it to us “for free” because of the mix-up. When they showed her to us, they said she looked “good,” but compared to how she looked just two hours earlier, this shave was completely unnecessary.

We’re heading into colder weather, and since yesterday she’s been showing behavior changes because she’s clearly uncomfortable, she’s essentially naked and cold. No apology was offered, and we were still expected to pay for the service. We didn’t want to cause a scene in front of other customers, but this experience was incredibly disappointing.

In the past, there were a couple of times when her trim was shorter than expected, but at least she still had her coat, we let those go. This time, however, was our last straw. I’m sharing this to warn other cat owners who may be considering this place. Mistakes like this can really impact your pet’s comfort and well-being.

The lady who trimmed cat claws was great, she really knew how to handle my cat, who was not making things easy for her. Everyone was professional, polite, friendly,  and very helpful.   They also made sure to take precautions when there was a large dog in the building.  The nail trim was a great and went super quick.  I recommend anyone looking for a quick nail trim for their cats to come here. Priceing was a good deal

The staff here are very nice and welcoming, but unfortunately the grooming service was very disappointing. I brought my dog in for a full grooming, and when I picked him up, he looked almost the same as when I dropped him off. His hair wasn’t clean properly, and by the next day he smelled really bad, as if he had only been quickly dried instead of actually bathed and groomed. For a dog with a lot of hair, I expected more thorough care, but it felt like I paid for something that wasn’t really done. Sadly, the experience wasn’t worth the money.
Love the groomin Room. Have been going there for many years. The staff is so friendly and professional  and they really do love your pets.

Took my dog there 3x. Never again . I had an appointment with Danielle and someone else did the grooming and I was never informed of the change until pickup time. She had a deep cut on her paw and the hair never grew back. The wound got infected, she also had cut near the anal area. They didn’t remove the hair from her ears or cut all her nails. She had one good grooming the previous month from Danielle.
They took care of my dog and made him feel special.

This place is great! All the people who work there were fantastic from making the appointment to being available the same day. Plus they were fantastic with my 🐶 which I couldn’t be happier with! I HIGHLY recommend them for anyone & their 🐕 …
Wouldn't take my dog anywhere else. The owner has wonderful customer service. Overall it is always a great experience.
I love my dogs color and cuts but the dark haired girl at the front seat is RUDE passive aggressive and obvious
I take my little girl here for grooming. She always sees Chrissy, who does an amazing job. My sweet girl always leaves there looking adorable and feeling good. I would definitely recommend them.
I absolutely love this groomer. They never miss!
Very nice and clean and very friendly people. ♥️ They took amazing care of my long haired cat and gave her a really cute cut that exceeded my expectations!
I have taken my cat Gus here for years. They do such a good job every time.

Love taking my fur here. Michelle and her team are awesome and very helpful.  So good with my baby. He is going to be 19, and they give him a little extra TLC.  Thank you!
I went to Gina for years at the Fkd Ave location and she was great, but left GR. Started going to the owner for years and now have switched to Sara. All have been excellent with my baby. Highly recommend.
P.S. let's not forget the main faces at GR who answer the phones, greet us (check in/out). Without them, there is no GR!  Thank you ladies for your endless hard work of juggling it all while trying to hear people on the phone with dogs barking, blow dryers going, and people talking out front.  You all rock! ❤️

I love this place they treat your animals like they are their own. I’ve been bringing my Jaxson and Rockie and they love it. John is the best followed him here because of how he is with my dogs patient and kind. Definitely the best!
I've been using them for 15yrs. Great service and professional care to my Daisy girl.
Always took my pets here the staff is great never had any issues at all and my dogs come out squeaky clean 🥰 …

Our 80lb. high energy Labradoodle has genuinely never looked better! The two ladies I spoke with were exceptionally nice, called me back quickly and answered all my questions, and were overall great. We will definitely be returning!
We love the Groomin Room ! Very easy to book an appointment & Carson's haircut always looks great!
My go to groomers! Love Samantha! I have 2 Shih Tzu's that go every month.
Maggie looks so beautiful.  They did such a great job!

Love the groomin room it’s conveniently located and coco always looks very cute after her cut I’m gonna get a picture next time we go and they send out little appointment reminders which is good cause coco is a goldendoodle and the breed in general has very fast growing hair.
Want to know if it closed down my dog missed it there Febo and Tink
Called for appointment on 1/30/25, person answering the phone very ignorant in speaking with customers. Need training in customer service. Makes business bad.

Made appointment for our dog.
3 hrs later he was done. Worst cut I've ever seen. A week later looks like he needs another cut. The sanitary cut was a joke. Way over priced for what they do. Look elsewhere.
They did a great job on khloe and King's haircut

We have been using the Groomin Room for our dog, Max, for years and have no complaints. We used the Mayfair location, even after we moved out of the neighborhood because we were so happy with their service. Now we go to the Morrell Ave location which is even more convenient.  They do a great job and their prices are very reasonable. My dog always comes hime with a cute little bandana but this time he came home with the cutest little scarf.

I highly recommend The Grromim Room!
Can't say anything bad about this place. It's all good . The best grooming place in Philadelphia

I used this service when the frankford chippendale location was open January2024. I would never use this service AGAIN. First the ladies were rude when I came into the building just unapproachable. I used the service because I was 8 months pregnant and I could not wash and cut my puppy hair myself. I have a poodle and once she is washed and blow dried her hair gets puffy. However when I picked up my puppy from her appointment her hair was still wrinkled which gives me the idea that she was just sprayed with cologne maybe. The cut was so uneven there was patches of dark and light spots. My pups facial hair was not shaved at all. Her private area was not trimmed for her hygiene. Service was $86 which i have no issue paying but the service was not good at this frankford location it was not. Neighbors of mine do not like the service there as well. I use the GREATER PHILADELPHIA FURRYLAND MOBILE SERVICE NOW FOR MY PUPPY. They do not disappoint and the truck will come to you. Look them up and leave the grooming room right where they are
